title: Finger hole on top, with an undercut bore
summary: The one finger hole is a vertical bore through the ridge of the back on the centre line, 7.05 mm across (7.25 mm as drawn for print): straight for 2.5 mm, then opening downward at the roof angle. It sits in a dimple 0.8 mm deep, and either hand finds it by feel.

rejected.value: a plain bore through the gable roof
rejected.why: 8 % less conductance at the same diameter (solved at 6.6 and 7.0 mm): 470 Hz then needs an estimated 7.5 to 7.6 mm, at or over the 7.5 mm the design spec set for a child's fingertip

returns_if.text: when the undercut prints with a ragged inner rim: a plain 7.6 mm bore is 7.8 mm as drawn, still inside the 8 mm of C8

rejected.value: a hole on the right flank of the back, 23 mm down-slope from the ridge (the print-first concept)
rejected.why: a dead flat seat that seals well, but one-handed: the right index finger lands on it and the left does not

returns_if.text: when a flat seat matters more than either hand, with a mirrored file for left hands
